messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tests to determine if medicine is effective"
set: ["tests to determine if medicine is effective", "tests can help your doctor determine if this medicine is effective", "this is normal and will not make the medicine less effective", "it is not effective for glycemic control", "will not make the medicine less effective", "after medicine is stopped", "do not assume medicine is to blame", "doctor will determine how long to treat", "adjust to the minimum effective dose", "blood tests if liver symptoms occur", "3 mg dose is not effective for glycemic control", "ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using this medicine", "blood tests performed every 6 to 12 months once dose is stable", "use effective birth control to avoid pregnancy", "doctor will determine appropriate dose", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have liver disease"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
